lines: 391,305 GitHub stars measure trust. This TypeScript assistant runs anywhere.
You stop using different tools everywhere, because this assistant runs on your own computer.
OpenClaw is your local AI assistant that helps in chats like Discord and Slack.
The Gateway controls sessions and tools locally.
Run the onboard command to install the local daemon. Then check the gateway status or open the dashboard.
The OpenClaw Foundation is an independent 501(c)(3). It is funded by donors including Amazon and Red Hat.
Connect messaging services like Discord or Slack to add tools and skills for running apps.
The repository is a pnpm workspace. The installer supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
It uses an MIT license and is built by the OpenClaw Foundation.
Type curl install script bash on macOS Linux or Windows to start.
Send this to someone who wants their AI assistant running locally on any device.
Your local AI runs on any device.
